interpretation: The exact-head broad V7 run is data-active but hard-executable evidence is dominated by missing full-snapshot lineage. The current API type/parser discards documented REST snapshot timestamp/hash fields, so the Fast runtime treats each non-fresh REST replacement as un-timestamped and execution-ineligible. This can create an avoidable coverage bottleneck. It is not alpha or fill/PnL evidence.

Use a fresh REST response only as a timestamped full point-in-time snapshot, never as proof of continuous WebSocket lineage.
Apply the same per-leg exchange-age and cross-leg-skew checks to synchronized REST full-snapshot evaluations.
Require monotone event clocks before applying later WS deltas so an out-of-order delta cannot regress snapshot state.
